proposals.title: Implement core nominal types and fixed-point arithmetic (ADR-004)
proposals.why_now: All FASE-1 deliverables (ledger, price generator, orders, tick loop) require branded types and deterministic integer arithmetic. ADR-004 is marked DEFINIR and must be authored before any division code is written. Without these primitives, no other package can be correctly implemented.

proposals.title: Implement canonical 10-step tick loop and spot market order execution
proposals.why_now: The canonical tick loop is the integration point of all FASE-1 components and is required before StateHash, save/replay, and the replay tool can be implemented. Market orders (buy/sell spot) are the only order type required in FASE-1. Together these form the minimal viable simulation core.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo scaffold, CI pipeline, ESLint §13 pure rules, dependency boundary checker (§14.5), and CanonicalEncoder (ADR-009) are fully implemented with tests. All other packages (world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, desktop apps, tools/replay, tools/bench) are empty stubs exporting nothing.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: Core domain primitives are entirely absent: branded nominal types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick), fixed-point arithmetic with explicit rounding modes, and positional RNG. Every remaining FASE-1 deliverable — ledger, price generator, orders, tick loop — depends on these foundations.

warnings: ADR-002 and ADR-004 are both marked DEFINIR and must be authored and committed as ADR documents before their corresponding implementations are written (per §15 acceptance criterion: 'ADR registrado para qualquer item marcado DEFINIR que a feature resolveu'). Any task that implements arithmetic or RNG without first writing the ADR violates the Definition of Done.

IMPACT_WINDOW (§5.1) and BOT_DECISION_PERIOD (§5.4) are also marked DEFINIR. They are not on the critical path for the first four proposals but will block macro event and bot simulation implementation in the latter half of FASE-1. These should be resolved and documented before those tasks are started.

The spec requires a minimal Electron installer (window open, even if empty) in FASE-1 with INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration=false, sandbox=true) enforced from the start. This is a TRAVADO sequencing constraint (§15, §17 step 8) that must not be deferred to later phases. None of the above proposals address it; it should be scheduled in parallel with or immediately after the tick loop.
